meaning: Both live T18 series joined in one file. Per-case raw answers stay in plans/P20/t18-hybrid-*/ and are gitignored, so this file is the citable record, not a derivation a clean clone can recompute. Nothing here is a human verdict.
whySeriesEndedAt18: The v2 run stopped on a transport failure and the harness does not retry a live call automatically, so twelve of the thirty sentences were never attempted. The series is closed at the eighteen cases that exist; it is not a 30/30 result and must never be written as one.

G-R.why: Measured over the original 30/30 series; no browser composition or live percentile closes it.

G-L.why: Same: a single live browser observation is not a p95 and the prompt-to-world budget is not met.

G-V.why: Three independent reviewers have not scored the gallery. study-cards.md is the prepared package, not the study.

G-A4.why: Ten real model interventions over fixtures exist; the five outside people do not.

G-P.why: Budgets measured on an RTX 3090; the target is a 1080p laptop and both viewports.

G-E.why: The import path is closed offline, but no new provider asset was generated or approved.

G-D.why: No authorized host, no public repository (the declared address returns 404) and no monitoring.

warnings: The two series are separate runs against different frozen sources. Their counts must not be added and their percentiles must not be merged.
A green unit test here means a stored result, never that the generation met the brief.
Model wall time includes transport and CLI waiting; it is not isolated inference time.
